irev.admin.title: IReV elections
irev.admin.intro: The INEC result-viewer elections this comparison uses. The server looks them up by itself and confirms one only when exactly one record matches the date, the race and the seat. Confirm or unconfirm here to override it; an election you unconfirm is never picked up again automatically.
irev.admin.why-confirm: Exactly one record matched the date, the race and the seat.
irev.admin.why-ambiguous: More than one record matches this seat. Check it on IReV before confirming.
irev.admin.why-unmatched: None of our races matches this record, so it cannot be confirmed here.
irev.admin.why-env: Set by IREV_ELECTION_ID on the server.
irev.admin.cov-final: {n} still had no sheet at the cut-off
irev.admin.chain-never: Has not looked for elections yet
irev.admin.chain-hourly: looking hourly — a polling date is near
irev.admin.chain-down: IReV not answering — retrying with backoff
irev.admin.panels: Agreed by the panel: {match} match · {mismatch} mismatch · {open} still open · {nosheet} with no sheet yet
irev.admin.none: No IReV elections found yet. INEC creates them a day or two before polling day; the server looks hourly from three days before.
irev.admin.group: {race}: {n} on IReV · {confirmed} confirmed · {open} need a decision
irev.admin.confirm-ask: Use this IReV election for {race} — {seat}? Our results for that seat will be compared with its sheets.
irev.admin.unconfirm-ask: Stop using this IReV election for {race} — {seat}? It will not be picked up again automatically until you confirm it.
irev.admin.done-confirmed: Confirmed. Its sheets will be checked on the next pass.
irev.admin.done-unconfirmed: Unconfirmed. It will not be used.
irev.admin.queued: Queued. The background worker starts it within a minute — refresh then.
irev.admin.started: Started. Refresh in a minute to see what it found.
